Cybersecurity: how do you choose your first priorities?

The right priority depends on your business, your exposure and the safeguards actually in place.

← All insights

Start with critical activities

Identify the services whose disruption would have the greatest impact. Connect them to the applications, identities and infrastructure on which they depend.

Check the fundamentals

Review privileged access, authentication, updates, backups and visibility into security events. Do not assume that a safeguard works without evidence to verify it.

Balance risk and feasibility

Assess potential impacts, exposure conditions and remediation effort. A useful plan distinguishes immediate actions from changes that need preparation.

Review priorities over time

Changes to an application, provider or organisation can change your exposure. Track and reassess the roadmap with the relevant owners.

This guidance is general. The appropriate scope and measures depend on the context of your organisation.
